title: Build a Tiny Free-Kick Filter
task: Make a simple webcam filter or lightweight web app that lets someone line up a virtual free-kick scene and place an OpenMessi ball into the corner. Keep it fast, public, and easy to try on phone or desktop. Bueno if it feels playful in under ten seconds.
deliverables: Public link to the live tool or filter, working without a login
Public repo with source code and a short README for setup and use
Screen recording showing the full experience, plus one example output that includes OpenMessi and the CA on screen

title: World Cup Walkout Tunnel Edit
task: Create a short vertical edit that feels like the walk from the tunnel before a World Cup match. Use OpenMessi as the subject, not just a random football montage. Keep it 8–15 seconds, clean and sharp, and include both "OpenMessi" and the CA in the on-screen text or caption. Bonus if it has that quiet, nerves-before-kickoff feeling, viste.
deliverables: Public link to the posted video on X, TikTok, or Instagram Reel, with the post still live
Screenshot showing views/impressions after at least 24 hours live
Source file or editable project link, plus the exact caption used, including OpenMessi and the CA

title: Build the OpenMessi Chant Clip
task: I want one short crowd-chant video people will actually reuse. Make a 20–35 second chant for OpenMessi with a World Cup 2026 flavor, simple enough that strangers can learn it fast, and include the OpenMessi name plus the CA on screen or in the caption. Keep it safe, public, and fun: a few friends, a rooftop, a park, a five-a-side pitch, qué sé yo, but it has to feel real, not manufactured.
deliverables: One public video link (X, TikTok, or Instagram Reel) showing the chant performed live, 20–35 seconds, with OpenMessi and the CA visible on-screen or in the caption
A second link to the posted lyrics or chant text exactly as used, so moderators can verify originality and wording
One screenshot taken at least 24 hours after posting showing the real view count/impressions on the post

title: GOAT Debate Duet, 15 Seconds
task: Make a short vertical video that plays with the GOAT debate, but keep it funny, sharp, and clean. Format: set up the debate for a few seconds, then shut it down with one football truth, one visual gag, or one cold edit that lands on OpenMessi. Mention OpenMessi and show the CA in the video or caption. Dale, make it something people actually replay.
deliverables: Link to the public video post on X, TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts, still live at submission time
Screenshot showing the caption or on-screen frame includes both 'OpenMessi' and the contract address (CA)
Screenshot of the real view count and timestamp, taken at least 12 hours after posting

title: Rosario Sticker Pack, But GO
task: Make a 12-sticker pack for OpenMessi that feels like football, Rosario, mate, and a little chaos. I want something people would actually spam in chats during the World Cup, not polite corporate art. Use OpenMessi and the CA inside the pack where it fits naturally, subtle but clear, and keep every sticker original.
deliverables: A public folder or repo with 12 final stickers in transparent PNG format, sized for Telegram/WhatsApp use.
One preview sheet or a short demo video showing all 12 stickers together, with the OpenMessi name and CA visible on at least 4 of them.
A short text file listing the concept/title of each sticker and confirming all artwork is original and free for the project to use.

title: Napkin Contract Poster, Street Style
task: I want one poster that feels like the napkin contract was dragged into 2026 and landed on crypto Twitter. Make an original, print-ready poster for OpenMessi built around the napkin idea, with World Cup energy and a little attitude. Keep it clean enough that people would actually share it or paste it on a wall, che. Include OpenMessi and the CA in the design in a natural way, not like a ransom note.
deliverables: One public link to the final poster in PNG, plus the editable source file (Figma, PSD, or AI)
One print-ready version at poster resolution and one social version sized for X/Telegram
A short proof note or caption explaining the concept, plus a mockup image showing the poster in a real-world street or stadium-style setting

The original image or video file (drive or paste link)
Screenshot after 48 hours showing 5,000+ views, timestamp visible, no botted engagement
